error[L0301]: `defer` registers a call, and this is a conversion
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/defer-registers-a-conversion/program.ldn:7:11
  |
7 |     defer i32(result)
  |           ^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/defer-registers-a-conversion/program.ldn:7:5

7 |     defer i32(result)
  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ this registration
  = note: [1100]/[1110]: the registered call runs when its block is left, and a conversion runs nothing
